statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current Tail remains low.
recommendation: Current evidence supports a low-Tail state while macro Stress remains extreme.
headline: Overnight conditions remain mixed as yields stay near 5.11% and oil eases
body: Fresh reporting shows the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield near 5.11% and Brent near $102 while Asian equities are mixed and U.S.-China trade-truce extension progress offsets some geopolitical pressure. Direct live NQ retracement-quality evidence remains limited, so Tail remains low rather than elevated.

lookbackSummary: Tail rose into the elevated band during Wednesday's rates-led selloff, peaked at 34%, then fell back to the high teens as meaningful mean reversion returned into the close and overnight conditions stabilized.
outlookSummary: Tail is low overnight. The next concentrated conditional danger window is 12:30-15:15 UTC around U.S. data, Fed remarks and the cash open; event proximity raises Stress, while Tail crosses the block threshold only if persistent one-way structure is actually observed.

forecast.analysis: Fresh overnight evidence is mixed: the U.S. 10-year yield is near 5.11% and Brent near $102, while Asian equities are mixed and trade-truce progress offsets some geopolitical pressure. Direct live NQ retracement detail remains limited, so Tail stays low.
drivers: Brent near $102 after easing from recent highs
Limited direct live NQ retracement-quality evidence

news.title: Bonds shaky, oil eases off highs amid trade, peace talks

forecast.analysis: If overnight price discovery remains two-way, Tail stays low. A fresh directional range break that holds near an extreme with weak retracements would be the first meaningful invalidation.
Low Tail remains the baseline if rotation persists through the late Asian session. Firm global yields keep Stress high even without renewed directional efficiency.
A stable pre-Europe range would preserve mean-reversion evidence. Repeated extension after failed retracements would be required to lift Tail materially.
European pre-open liquidity can widen moves, but Tail remains low unless directional extension becomes persistent and pullbacks stay shallow.
As Europe opens, cross-asset confirmation becomes more important. Persistent NQ weakness aligned with firm yields would raise conditional Tail from its low overnight base.
John Williams's 04:10 ET moderated discussion is a policy checkpoint. Tail remains low unless the observed reaction becomes persistently directional and resists meaningful retracement.
After the Williams discussion, Tail stays low if price discovery remains two-way; a directional response that survives retracement would raise concern.
U.S. pre-market participation becomes more important. Only sustained extension with shallow pullbacks would justify a higher Tail state.
U.S. pre-market participation becomes more important. Only sustained extension with shallow pullbacks would justify a higher Tail state.
Approaching the 08:30 ET U.S. data cluster raises Stress. Tail moves to watch, but no release outcome or one-way reaction is assumed before it occurs.
drivers: 08:30 ET claims and BEA data cluster

forecast.analysis: The 08:30 ET releases and 08:50 ET Hammack remarks create a dense catalyst window. Tail stays at watch unless the observed reaction becomes persistently directional with weak retracements.
drivers: Initial jobless claims and BEA release at 08:30 ET
Beth Hammack opening remarks at 08:50 ET

forecast.analysis: Into the U.S. cash open, Tail is conditionally elevated only if post-data direction persists, NQ holds near an extreme, and pullbacks remain shallow. A two-way open would argue for rapid de-escalation.

The 10:00 ET New Residential Sales release overlaps the opening price-discovery window. Tail is conditionally elevated if one-way extension survives retracements; orderly rotation would invalidate the elevated path.
After the data/opening cluster, Tail remains elevated only if directional efficiency persists. Meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization would move the state back toward watch.
As the concentrated catalyst window fades, Tail falls to watch if two-way trade returns. Continued extension after failed pullbacks would delay normalization.
Midday U.S. trading carries lower conditional Tail if price discovery broadens and retracements deepen; persistent extreme-holding would keep the watch state active.
Later-session Tail remains at watch while residual rates and geopolitical pressure persist. A balanced tape would support further de-escalation.
Tail returns to low if the session remains rotational into the afternoon. Renewed one-way extension would be the main invalidation.
If the cash session closes with two-way price discovery and no fresh catalyst shock, low Tail remains appropriate despite elevated macro Stress.
Post-close conditions should carry low Tail unless futures immediately reopen into a directional break with weak retracements.
Thin evening liquidity favors a low-Tail baseline, while sudden geopolitical headlines remain a Stress amplifier rather than automatic Tail evidence.
Overnight Tail stays low if futures remain balanced. A persistent move aligned with yields and technology breadth would be needed to lift the path materially.
Early Friday overnight trade remains low Tail unless a fresh directional regime forms. The next scheduled U.S. high-impact macro checkpoint is durable-goods data later Friday.
drivers: Friday durable-goods checkpoint later in the session
